title: Archive Services / Source Header Analysis
summary: Technical analysis of a recurring source-header anomaly.
body:
Analysis of the affected files indicates that the source header is structurally valid.

The header identifies the originating system as:

BRIGHTSIDE REGIONAL ARCHIVE
NODE: R-17

No such active node exists in the current network registry.

Of note, the affected files do not contain transmission errors. They appear to have been generated correctly.

Further technical details withheld pending review.
